data.about:
Shinbo Akiyuki is a freelance director who is now working with Shaft as an educator. He says that the reason he sticks with Shaft is due to their system and professional and digital capacity, which makes his expression of direction much easier.

The so-called "Team Shinbo" includes Shinbo Akiyuki, Oishi Tatsuya, and Oonuma Shin.

Alias:

Futoshi Shiiya

Jyuhachi Minamizawa

Soji Homura
